mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (user_id, order_item_id, goods_id, shop_id, rating, content, images) VALUES (#{userId}, #{orderItemId}, #{goodsId}, #{shopId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{images})
mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM review r WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review WHERE goods_id = #{goodsId}

SELECT r.*, g.name AS goodsName, u.nickname FROM review r LEFT JOIN goods g ON r.goods_id = g.id LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.shop_id = #{shopId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review WHERE shop_id = #{shopId}
mapper.update: UPDATE review SET reply = #{content} WHERE id = #{id} AND shop_id = #{shopId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM review WHERE order_item_id = #{orderItemId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE review SET content = #{content}, images = #{images} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(rating), 0) AS avgRating, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rating >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS positiveCount, COUNT(*) AS total FROM review WHERE shop_id = #{shopId}
